fields.name: External key
fields.definition: The URL-safe string form of a shard key, produced by `ToExternalString()` and reversed by `FromExternalString()`. It is used to carry a sharded record identity as a single value across REST routes, JSON payloads and similar boundaries. The string is obfuscated and carries a short checksum, so accidental alteration or casual tampering is detected on parsing. It is not encryption or a signature and must not be relied on for authorization.
